body:
N-34 SLICE 3 IS BUILT, NOT WALKED (helper-n34s3, 24 Nov 2026; server only; branch task/N-34-slice3-new-keeps; PR #129; the item stays todo, slices 4 to 7 are open; nothing marked; no device, VM or live request).

BUILT: Keeper._identified asks album_pass.KeepAsker between the download and the tags: the pass's own selection (wanting, for one ref), matcher (decide) and write rule (commit_verdict, moved out of the pass unchanged), with the downloaded file's own length (file_or_listing_length, the one reader). tags_of, plan_for_ref, write_folder_picture and textnorm.is_placeholder_album are the one definitions. B-110 cause: _existing takes the song's own file first (a youtube row under Encore, still on disk), a file at the planned place only when no other ref holds its path. Dry run: --new-keeps and a NEW KEEPS section (selection, matcher and planner shared; a test runs report and real keeper and compares). No migration.

RULES, each pinned by a named test (tests/test_keeper_new_keeps.py, test_new_keeps_selection.py, test_new_keeps_dryrun.py; 42 mutants, 41 killed, 1 equivalent named in the PR): an album only from matched; a catalogue that cannot be asked never delays or stops a keep (10 s for the whole question) and nothing is remembered for it; a real album is never rewritten; the Host's files are never touched.

DECISIONS TAKEN (easy to undo; say if you disagree): (1) NO removal of an extra copy: audit B-110 says remove it, the design says only find the file, a delete has no undo; it goes to slice 5 and its design row now says it must handle a ref with two files. (2) The placeholder album is no album in the planner and the tag builder: a ref carrying it goes to Singles, not to a folder named [Unknown Album] (B-110's own example). (3) Budget: 10 s in all (the design's figure), priced in the constant; a keep during a busy gate may stay in Singles and is placed later. (4) The folder picture is written only for a catalogue picture and only in an album folder.

DEPLOY PRECONDITION (RC 4b updated): no image with slice 3 runs on a server the project runs before python -m encore_server.album_dryrun --new-keeps has been read over a copy of THAT server's database: a stamp now reaches the disk at keep time.

STOP-GAPS: none added; the keeper's listed-length stop-gap of slice 2 is closed; single window, compilation markers and recheck_pending (N-36) are unchanged with their own triggers and task (N-34 itself, N-36).

NOT DONE: slices 4 to 7; files already kept; a song with a catalogue id and no album is not asked (the pass does not ask it either). A board item for the extra-copy removal does not exist: it is inside slice 5 of N-34.
